E.g., early in an episode (ball still in front of the door) the first disjunct is false but the second is false too — that part aligns — yet if a ball were placed elsewhere or the door scan matched a different door orientation, truth diverges from the spec; more importantly the disjunction with 'no door on grid' is semantically unrelated and would make `blocker_moved` true in a doorless grid, which never matches this task's intended reading and can corrupt RM state. Note the RM requires blocker_moved as defined (u0→u1 gate), so an incorrect blocker_moved breaks reward alignment.
